g.text: AWS Cloud — Sydney (ap-southeast-2) · 8 × m7i-flex.large (2 vCPU, 8 GB)
↓ SSH: start DataNode / Worker, drop page cache, start / stop sar
↕ register + heartbeat (hdfs://master:9000, spark://master:7077), tasks and results
each worker: HDFS DataNode · Spark executor (2 cores, 3 GB)
Firewall: SSH only from the operator's IP; all traffic allowed between the 8 nodes (same network, one availability zone)
